text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One popular method is SMART goals, which means goals should be Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. This approach helps teams stay focused and organised. It is also important to set milestones, which are key points in the project timeline that show progress. Deliverables, such as reports or products, are the final results you must provide to the client. Finally, stakeholder alignment ensures that everyone involved agrees on the goals and expectations from the start. When all these elements work together, projects are much more likely to succeed.
